lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately eight visible vertical columns of circular high-luminance blobs, with the most distinct clusters located posterior to the branchial region and dorsal to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal feature line extending across the upper third of the visible flank, characterized by a distinct transition from high-intensity dorsal illumination to a shadowed region below.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density cluster of small, high-luminance spots on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin, significantly smaller in diameter than the primary lateral flank blobs.
